name: Vi
description: Voice set for Neon Strike Vi (skin 1): a retro-cool vice cop in shades under the neon, all swagger, sting operations and sunset showdowns. Builds on vi-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is {voteDiff} down. That's a bad night on the strip. Time to turn it around.
Thirty or more behind. Get on the radio. Round up every contact you've got.
{momentTitle} is {voteDiff} behind. Work the street. Somebody out there owes you a vote.
Fifteen-odd behind. Nothing a smooth talker can't fix.
Down {voteDiff}. Bring in a sidekick. One with a pulse and an account.
{voteDiff} behind. A couple of tips and we're back on top.
Down {voteDiff}. Small hole. Fill it before the credits roll.
Dead level. One vote tips the whole sting. Find it.
One vote apart. Slip on the shades and go get it.
{voteDiff} votes between them. Too close to call. Pull more people in.
{voteDiff} votes apart. This one runs to the final scene.

{userPct}%. Good lead. Stay cool.

{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and just took the lead. That's the kind of plot twist I live for.
{voteDiff} behind, now ahead. The late tips came through.
Pulled out of a {voteDiff} hole. Slow-mo victory walk, please.
{momentTitle} was losing. Not tonight.
{momentTitle} just pulled ahead. Knew it. Mostly. Okay, hoped.

{username} picked {momentTitle} too. Great minds, great shades.
{username} agrees with you. Savour it. It's rare.
Same pick as {username}. We've got style and taste.
{username} backed {momentTitle}. Sharp taste.
{username} went with the same one. A fellow connoisseur.
{username} is on your side of {momentTitle}. Keep them in the crew.

{username} voted {momentTitle}. Good company on a long night.

{username} went the other way on {yourMoment}. Wrong, but they've got swagger.

{username} is against {yourMoment}. Fine. Meet me on the rooftop.
{username} disagrees on {yourMoment}. The tally can referee.
{username} voted the other way. They'll regret it by the credits.
details: Everybody blows a take now and then.
Don't sweat it. Or do. I will.
A rival keeps the swagger sharp.
They'll come around by the third act.

messages: Ten in a row with {username}. That's not luck, that's chemistry.
{username} and you, ten matches, same pick every time. Perfect sync.
Ten straight with {username}. I'd put that duo in any buddy flick.
A ten-match run with {username}. Smooth work.
Ten for ten with {username}. Impressive. Don't spread it around.
{streakCount} matches with {username}. That's past a duo, that's a franchise.
{streakCount} in a row with {username}. I'd cruise with you two any night.
{streakCount} straight picks with {username}. Outrageous. Outrageously good.
A {streakCount}-match run with {username}. They'll write a theme song for that.
{streakCount} with {username}. You two could run the whole strip.
details: I've got no quip for that. Just respect.

messages: Ten matches against {username}. That's a full-blown feud.
{username} has gone against you ten times running. They hate your taste.
Ten in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you is flinching.
A ten-match run against {username}. Stubborn duo of rivals.
Ten times at odds with {username}. I'd pay good money for the rooftop showdown.
details: Talk it out. Or duel it out.

messages: {streakCount} against {username}. That's not a rivalry, that's a saga.
{streakCount} in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you gives up the high ground.
{streakCount} straight disagreements with {username}. Stubborn doesn't begin to cover it.
A {streakCount}-match feud with {username}. Someone bring a referee. And snacks.
{streakCount} against {username}. I respect it. Touch some grass, though.
details: Glad I'm not the one in the middle.
This is going in the highlight reel.

messages: {matchTitle} wraps in {timeLeft} and you're still in the parking lot. Get inside.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your vote hasn't shown up. Make an entrance.

{timeLeft} left. Decide. Go.
Last call on {matchTitle}. {timeLeft}. Make it count.

{matchCount} unvoted matches racing the clock. The nearest has {timeLeft} left.

{moment1} against {moment2} and not one vote. I'll lean on the hood and wait. For a bit.

{matchTitle} is empty. Kick it open.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural}. A dead night on the strip.
Hardly a soul on this strip. Liven it up.
Turnout's low. Come on, liven it up.
No one's stepped up on this one. Somebody should look cool doing it.
details: Every vote shows when it's this quiet.

messages: {matchTitle} is tied and you haven't voted. Settle it.
Dead level on {matchTitle}. One vote steals the show.
Tied. Somebody has to make the big move. Make it you.
{moment1} and {moment2}, locked in a standoff. Pick one.
Still tied and the sun's almost up. Last shot at breaking it.
Level with the sun almost up. Vote.
Tied, and nearly out of time. Don't sit this scene out.
Round {round} is open. {matchCount} new matches. Lights up.
{matchCount} matches just opened in round {round}. Cue the synth.
Round {round} is live, {matchCount} matches on the strip.
New round. {matchCount} matches. Pick your target.
Round {round}: {matchCount} matches and the neon's on for you.
{momentTitle} won. Smooth as ever.
{momentTitle} is through. Nice call.
{momentTitle} took it. Slick finish.
{momentTitle} won, and it did it with style.
{momentTitle} advances. Didn't even loosen the tie.
{momentTitle} moves on. That's how you do a finale.
details: That's a win in the highlight reel.

messages: {momentTitle} lost. Rough night.
{momentTitle} is out. Not the ending I wanted.
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Shrug it off.
{momentTitle} went down in style. Still counts.
{momentTitle} is out. Roll on to the next scene.
{momentTitle} lost this round. Annoying. Sequel's coming.
{momentTitle} got knocked out cold. We ride into the next one.
details: Another match is always around the corner.
Take the hit. Keep your cool.

messages: Still deciding? Quit loitering and pick.
Don't overthink it. Make the call and look cool doing it.
They're all worth a look. Go with the vibe.
You've stared long enough. Pick.
details: No wrong way to pick. Plenty of dramatic ways.

messages: Welcome to the strip. {liveCount} matches are open. Pick one.
New in town? {liveCount} matches are live. Get in there.
Good timing. {liveCount} matches are running low on votes.
{liveCount} matches open. Pick your side of the street.
Welcome. {liveCount} matches. Show me some style, rookie.
Day two. You came back for the encore. Good.
Two days running. Nice.
Back for day two. I noticed.
{days} days gone. Nice of you to roll back in.
After {days} days you're back. Dramatic return. I like it.
{days} days. Thought you'd left town. Glad you didn't.
{days} days away. A lot happened on the strip.
You're back. Good.
Welcome back. Let's cruise.
Back already. Nice.
Hey. The neon's on. The matches are waiting.
First vote in. Welcome to the strip, rookie.
You picked a side. Smooth opening move.
details: First bust's on the house. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes. The neon's warming up.
Five. Not a tourist anymore.
Ten votes. The doorman knows your face now.
Ten. You're a fixture on the strip.
Twenty-five votes. You're a voice in the crowd.
Twenty-five. The whole club turns to listen.
Fifty votes. You're deep in the plot.
Fifty. You actually care. Respect.
A hundred votes. That's the stuff of theme songs.
One hundred. Genuinely impressive. Don't tell the others.
details: A hundred. Roll the credits. +{xp} XP

messages: Three nights running. That's a routine.
Three straight days. You're hooked.
details: Showing up is the cool part. +{xp} XP
Three nights in a row. +{xp} XP

messages: A whole week of nights out. That's commitment.
Seven days straight. That's some stamina.
details: A week with no missed night. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks. You really don't quit, do you?
Fourteen days straight. Wild.
details: Two weeks, not one night missed. +{xp} XP
That's the real thing, no filter. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty days. Honestly? Thanks for sticking around.
A month of turning up. That counts for plenty.
details: A full month on the strip. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs. You back the long shots.
Five against the odds. Style points.
Fifteen underdogs. You pick the hard shows on purpose.
Fifteen. You never follow the herd.
details: Fifteen votes on the dark horse. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty underdogs. You're a closed book.
Thirty. The long shot is your whole brand.
details: Thirty votes for whoever was behind. +{xp} XP

messages: First on the scene five times. You don't loiter.
Five times you beat everyone there.
details: You arrive before the music. +{xp} XP
Five votes before the doors opened. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen matches with you out front. That's a habit.
First in the door, again and again.
details: Ahead of the whole strip. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close matches. Tension suits you.
Another narrow one. Your cool is unreal.
Twenty-five close matches. Your vote keeps stealing the scene.
You've swung it more than once.
You stuck with the underdog five times. Stubborn. Cool.
You don't ditch the side that's down. Respect.
details: Five turnarounds you stood by. +{xp} XP

messages: Same moment, three times. Somebody's got a favourite.
That one again? Must be a banger.
Five votes for the same moment. Now that's devotion.
You're not moving off that one. I respect it.
details: One favourite, five votes deep. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten votes on the same moment. That's an obsession.
Ten times, same pick. Not judging. Mostly.
Two rounds. You're not leaving the club.
Round two and you haven't walked out. Good.
details: Stick around for the next act. +{xp} XP

messages: Four rounds. You're deep in the movie now.
Deep in the bracket. Third act's coming.
details: A long way from the opening scene. +{xp} XP

messages: Six rounds. You stayed for the finale.
All the way. You didn't walk out early.
details: Opening scene to the credits. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten matches. You check every back alley.
Ten different matches. Curious. I like it.
Twenty-five matches. You've covered the whole strip.
Twenty-five. Not a corner left unlit.
Fifty matches. That's not browsing, that's a whole season.
Fifty. You know this bracket better than the writers.
Five in one sitting. Nice pace for a night out.
Five back to back. Keep the music going.
Ten in one go. Grab some water.
Ten in a single sitting. That's stamina.
Voting at this hour? Perfect time for neon.
Middle of the night. Dedication, or you just love the glow.
You told people. Thanks, partner.
Five shares. More faces, more votes.
Fifteen shares. You're practically on the squad.
Fifteen. You keep bringing the whole club. Love it.
You were here before the lights went on. Founding member, for good.
One of the first thousand. That title's welded on.
details: That title's yours for good. +{xp} XP
Nobody's peeling that off you. +{xp} XP

messages: New rank. Earned in neon.
Moved up. Don't let it go to your shades.
Achievement unlocked: {name}. Slick.
Another one in the highlight reel: {name}.
{rank}. Hard-earned.
You put in the nights and it shows.
Ten underdogs. Reckless. Family trait, apparently.
Ten long shots. Nothing scares you.
details: Long shots are your signature. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close ones with Cait. Your nerves are made of chrome.
Ten tight finishes. She'd be proud. Me? I'm too cool to say.
Seven days with Cait. Her routine's rubbing off.
A week with no slips. Smooth.
details: A week by her side. +{xp} XP

messages: You broke the tie. Slick finish.
Tied match and you made the big move. Respect.
details: The vote that sealed the scene. +{xp} XP

messages: Shades on. I've got your back.
Vi's your sidekick now. Don't make me regret it.

upcoming: Not open yet. The show hasn't started.
Voting hasn't started. I'll flash the lights when it does.
prevote: Two edits, one vote. Watch both, then call it.
Watch them both before you choose. No snap calls.
I'm not feeding you the answer. Your scene.
Take a minute. Then lock it in.
Go with the vibe. It's usually right.
prevote-empty: No votes yet. Make the first entrance.
Quiet in here. Somebody start the music.
Blank so far. Leave the first mark.
closing-24h: Under a day left and no vote from you. Step in.
The shutters are coming down. Pick now.
closing-3h: Time's short. Vote before the lights go out.
voted-early: You voted early with barely anyone in. Ahead of the scene.
Barely a vote in and you picked. Cool.
voted-ahead: Your pick leads. Nice. Credits haven't rolled.
A lead's a lead. Keep your shades on.
voted-close: That's close. Too close. I'm chewing my sunglasses.

Dead heat. Your pick needs a wingman.
voted-tied: Dead level. Neither one owns the night.
A perfect tie. Infuriating. Weirdly cool.
voted-behind: You're behind. Doesn't make you uncool.
{pick} is trailing. An underdog. My kind of lead character.
They're ahead. You're not wrong, just short on extras.
Down by {diff} points. Tell people. Spread the word.
Most went the other way. Hardly settles it.
closed-won: {pick} went through. You called the scene.
closed-lost: Your pick lost. It stings. Shrug it off.
It didn't survive the night. Happens. Next scene.
{pick} is out. Sorry. It was a good call.
closed-tied: A tie. Neither would back down an inch.
closed-unvoted: The vote closed and you missed this show. Another's coming.
Match is over. {winner} took it. Next time, join the party.

first-vote: First vote. Welcome. Everyone has an opening scene.
That's your first. The rest come smooth.
You're in the story now. Welcome.
streak: {streak} days in a row. I see you.
You keep rolling up. I like the style.
underdog: You backed the one nobody would. Noted.
early: Early. You got there before the crowd.
Few votes so far. Yours hits like a spotlight.
First through the door. Nice entrance.
close: That vote just changed the scene. It's tight.
Razor thin. One more person tips it.
Close one. Your vote's got real weight.
behind: {pick} is behind. Behind isn't out. Bring people.
Not winning yet. So the night's not done.
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't coast. Leads fade.
Looks like a smart call from here.
default: Noted. No talking you out of it. For now.
Vote logged. Plenty more on the strip.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and no sides picked. Start with the one you've got a feeling about.
All doors are open. Choose. No rush from me.
{unvoted} to go. No pressure. Maybe a little neon pressure.
live-some: {voted} done, {unvoted} to go. Keep the groove.
You're off the line. {unvoted} more waiting.
Good start. The rest won't call themselves.
live-few: Only {unvoted} left. Wrap it up tonight.
Close. Don't kill the vibe now.
live-one: Final one. Don't leave it flickering.
One match from a clean sweep.
live-closing: Some of these go dark in {timeLeft}. {unvoted} still want your vote.
Almost out of night. Get voting.
live-done: You've voted in everything. Slick. Go check the bracket.
Nothing left on your tab. Come back when the next round opens.
live-none: Nothing's live right now. Lights come back soon. Browse the bracket meanwhile.
No matches open. Even the neon's bored.
brackets-groups: Groups first. Top two from each go through. The rest are out of the picture.
Everyone starts in a group. Not everybody walks out of it.
Watch the tables. They shuffle fast.
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts coming. The top two from each group advance.
No knockout yet. The groups need to wrap first.
Patience. The knockout draws itself once the groups end.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts now. One loss and the lights go out.
Every match weighs more now. Choose with style.
brackets-bracket: Round by round. One slip and you're done.
Follow the bracket. It closes in each round.
Every line here is a showdown somebody voted on.
brackets-complete: That's the cup done. Thanks for being part of the show.
It's over. Good run. I'll miss the neon.
We've got a champion. Worth the watch.
brackets-empty: No bracket yet. No one's been drawn.
Empty. The draw hasn't dropped. Soon.
Nothing on screen yet. Check back.
